nom: COSRX BHA Blackhead Power Liquid Treatment

avis.texte: I have dry, sensitive skin and acne and this is one of the only BHA products I've been able to use consistently without irritation. It's surprisingly hydrating and doesn't dry out my skin. Great starter BHA. Maybe not the best for very oily, acne-prone skin that needs a higher concentration.

I'm a 54 year old with chronic cystic/hormonal acne. I ran out of my prescription topical lotion (which wasn't very effective to begin with) and couldn't get to the Dr. for a refill, so I started experimenting with every treatment I could find. Within a week using this liquid, only at bedtime, my face is clear. I'm truly amazed and was scared to even write this review - afraid to jinx my results. But if I couldn't gatekeep this any longer, if it helps just one person like me who has felt so helpless about my condition. I do use a tiny bit of mixsoon bean lotion to hydrate, but I have no complaints, only praise!!

I'm very disappointed in this product. It doesn't do any type of poor cleansing. It is pretty much just a face gloss. I have large pores and blackheads and whiteheads and this does no type of cleansing whatsoever. I'm so disappointed.

I had high hopes for this product because I love the snail serum, love that stuff. I do struggle with blackheads and gave this a good month before I wrote a review. I didn't see a noticable difference in amount of blackheads. Will not buy again.

One of my top skincare products, I've been using and repurchasing for close to 6 years now, it's a staple. Easy to apply, the bottle lasts forever, and has really helped keep my skin clear and bright. I apply at night after cleansing.

I bout this hoping it would help with my Blackheads and make me pores appear smaller but I can't tell a difference after using for about 2 weeks and only made my acne worse and break out more, also after applying my face was sticky and red, I don't recommend.

avis.titre: I never write reviews but it's a game changer
avis.texte: I always hated having black heads specially when they would get enhanced when putting foundation over it, Nothing has ever worked for me besides squizing them out which I know you shouldn't do …. But this right here changed it all!!! I do get somw blocked pores but it seems lije the black heads tale longer to form since i started usung it. I wouod probably suggest applying it every otger night to avoid skin peeling. Never stop selling this Ulta

avis.titre: I've notice the difference since the first week!
avis.texte: Definitely on my night routine!!!! Ive always struggled with black heads and i would do my weekly picking on them (i know you shouldn't) …. But its been a week of using this stuff and my skin is super clear! Ulta please don't discontinue this product !!!!

Scrolling through ulta and noticed this product doesn't have a lot of reviews. I wish i had photos to show proof! Because i have HUGE poors and i hate them. i get more sebaceous filaments than blackheads, so I can't say too much on those, but it 100% will help with sebaceous filaments! AND SHRINKING THE APPEARANCE OF PORES. seriously cannot believe that I finally found a product that actuallyyy helps with the large look of my pores. ive been trying things for years and this is the only one that made a visible differance. im 30 y/o and have had acne issues since puberty, papules, blackhead, whitehead, cystic, scarring, hyperpigmentation, flakey and dry at the same time. i'm anemic, multiple vitamin deficiencys and undiagnosed POTS. i started by using once a week because i was scared it would dry me out bad, 2nd week twice, 3rd week 3 times and now every other day regularly after lotion, before serums & end in a heavy cream for hyperpigmentation. i never dried out or got oily and ive noticed a big differance in my acne over all, however idk if its related to this because i started taking Zinc around the same time for cystic acne on my jaw. Its definitely worth your money to try this one out! Im really happy with it & It's the same size as the 96 snail mucin and one of those bottles lasted me two years, so assuming this one will too!
I dont reach for this everyday but i do on those days my skin has clogged pores or feels rough or bumpy. It makes my skin soft and smoother looking. One of my favorites st the moment

Writing this review on 10/1/24, I purchased this product in July 2024 and have been using it daily since, sometimes twice a day. So I feel I have had plenty of time using it to write my honest review. I have very oily skin with large pores, and very occasional dryness, also acne prone. It has done absolutely nothing for my blackheads or my pores. The product goes on easily and absorbs fast, but thats about all I like about it. I am pretty disappointed since it has such great reviews, unfortunately it just hasn't worked for me. I will not repurchase and i homestly wouldn't recommend anyone else to either.

I got this recommendation from a Ulta staff member who worked the Benefit Brow bar, and I'm so glad I tried this. I've had a rough bumpy patch on my chin for YEARS never knowing how to get rid of it. I used this solution for 2-3 weeks straight and slowly saw results! I used it in the morning (with SPF) and at night. The pores on my chin are getting smaller and there's definitely less tiny bumps of white on my chin. I used this on my nose, t-zone, and nostril area but am waiting to see more results. I wear glasses so those areas get extra oily through the day. The only thing I will say is to not use any other creams and acne products while using this. I put on a Benzoyl Peroxide cream on top of this and it burns, so avoid mixing acne products if you can. Witch hazel and non-fragrance moisturizer seems to be fine for me. I am always going between products that don't seem to give me the results I want. Some have given me bad reactions and so I really stripped down my skin care routine out of fear and new sensitivity. But this is the first product in a long time that makes me happy!!! TRY IT !!
I bought this product after seeing great reviews and looking into it some, after a week I had already started seeing great results softer skin and my acne start to die down.100% would recommend
I bought this product after seeing great reviews and looking into it some, after a week I had already started seeing results softer skin and my acne stores a die down. 100% would recommend

This product was pretty good. I can't say it did too much for my blackheads, but it did help with oil. I started using it on my shoulders and they're looking fantastic, my acne and big pores there are minimized. I am confused how it did a better job on my shoulders than my face
I have noticed a big difference in the amount and size of my blackheads in just the few weeks of using this.

Ive been using this twice a day daily. Once in the morning before work and once in the afternoon after i shower. (About half a pump each time) I get a lot of black heads on my nose and this has helped so much in just 3 days! I can tell its been pulling black heads out of my pores and Ive already had someone comment on the results. I would say a good 80% of the black heads are gone. This is the first product by this brand that ive tried and i am pleased to say i will def be repurchasing

avis.titre: Clears blackheads/clogged pores but will go through purge
avis.texte: This helped decongest my pores after only one use. I was worried about using too much due to reading reviews saying this was basically giving people chemical burn but personally i've been able to use a full pump (directly onto skin, not even using a cotton pad) with no irritation. I have very deep pores that i have trouble getting makeup out of even after double cleansing and using a toner. This has been the only thing that I have gotten next day results from. I will say it smells awful after getting it on your skin, but it does fade off quickly. Also my skin is purging and i am breaking out, but basically its pulling out all the gunk deep from my pores and thats why im breaking out, it is normal to break out for a week or two after you first start using a product like this. I would recommend this to anyone with deep pores that are hard to clean and anyone who is patient to receive long term results as far as full cell turn over and glowing skin. But as far as same week results it 1000% decongested my pores and i dont have to sit there and squeeze the gunk out of my chin and around my nose. Hoping in a few months I will have glowing skin and smaller pores!

avis.titre: Prepare for a purge. I promise it's worth it.
avis.texte: My skin has gotten worse with shifting hormones in my 40s. Using morning and night on a clean face, I had the worst purge for 4 weeks, then my skin cleared and calmed almost completely. I still get occasional deep cysts around my cycle, but the constant churning acne around my chin, cheeks, and forehead is just gone. It's been a year now, and I cannot recommend this stuff enough.

If you're a person that needs instant gratification, look elsewhere. If you want a product that you can commit to using consistently in your facial routine and can wait a while before seeing results that are not short-term fixes, then this product is for you. (A little about my skin - I have large pores and oily skin. So my skin is predisposed to blackheads and whiteheads. I also have rosacea and my skin easily reddens.) I was about 2/3 through my first bottle before I looked in the mirror and though "Wow… the blackheads I've had my whole life on my chin are almost all gone and the ones on my nose are significantly less." The first couple weeks i wasnt too excited because i did note it causing some dry skin. But it was mild and a change of my moisturizer solved the problem. I use two pumps that I put in the palms of my hands and then pat all over my face, under my chin and chest. I use this morning and night. Its the only product i use for both morning and night routines. It has a very faint chemical smell but it dries fairly quick and the smell doesn't last at all. Blackheads are about 75% less than before and i hardly ever get zits now. I'm nealy done with my second bottle and will definitely buy again.

So ill out this out there i use the whole cosrx acne line together not just thos product but i do know when i stop using one for a while like this ine is for boack heads they will pop back up or the while heads and sp forth thats why i use then together they are an amazing line and they dont dry or irritate the skin like some acne lines
This products actually does what it says its going to do. It has helped clear my black heads tremendously.

avis.titre: Broke me out HORRIBLY hundreds of pimples from it
avis.texte: I dont know if im allergic or something but i originally bought this for my back so i didnt waste my paulas choice one. I woke up the next day and its either a horrendous breakout or an allergic reaction. Ive never had anything like that happen before.

avis.titre: My skin was clear now I broke out in bumps
avis.texte: Dont get this if you love clear skin, applied it right and EVERYTHING horrible product now i have to spend more money to get the break out situated
I was disappointed because i like this brand but this product made me break out

avis.titre: Bought this for my husband but snatched it back
avis.texte: My husband was complaining about blackheads he needed help with so I got this product for him. He said he thought it helped. So I tried it. Since I do not have blackhead issues I figured I would just try it on my nose. Then branched out a bit. Now use all over my face. Unsure how or why it works so well but I do prefer this to the snail mucin one. This creates a smooth canvas for makeup application. Have not noticed any drying effects however it has helped with t-zone oil. Think it reduces pore size. No breakouts from it. I am almost 58. Happy I bought it. Will purchase again.

Before the onset of deodorants with actives in them, I started using this to apply to my armpits after showering. Since then, I have stopped producing odor from my armpits even after working out or doing laborious chores. This has also significantly reduced the appearance of the pores on my nose, but it does require consistent use as with any salicylic acid treatment. Unlike other salicylic acids however, this is hydrating and non-irritating. I hope they never discontinue this because it's a true love of mine.

avis.titre: Holy grail for oily, acne prone skin
avis.texte: I love this product! Every time I breakout I use it at night, and i see an immediate reduction in the size of my pimples. Haven't used it long enough to see if it's made a reduction in pore size yet, but so far so good.

This is a highly effective product if you know how to use it and what products not to mix it with. I have sensitive, combination, acne prone skin. My skin is also use to using acid based products. If you have congested pores, which I had pretty bad in my t-zone area, this is for you! It helped to clear my open blackheads and get rid of their rough bumpy texture. My forehead is starting to get that glassy clear flat look again. The ingredients in this products and levels of concentration are amazingggg.

avis.titre: It did nothing for my blackheads
avis.texte: I gave it the benefit of the doubt and tried it for a while and nothing blackheads were still noticeably and it kind of made me breakout a little bit so with that being said I discontinued any use of it this was a fail for me 😑

I like this product and have recommended many times. HOWEVER, since I started using the BHA toner (which has been at least 3 years), there has always been an issue with every single bottle. The pump leaks every time you push it. It bubbles out all around the top and it is super frustrating because I just feel like theres no way to avoid wasting 20% of the bottle.

I used to use paula's choice 2% salicylic acid, which was good, but it triggered my fungal acne. This is perfect for me skin. It stings less so I can tell it's not as strong as Paula's choice but it does the job. I also like how it's more serum-like than liquid. You also get way more product than Paula's choice.

I didn't realize how well this product worked until I ran out! It makes the hugest difference for my blackheads and oily skin. Because it clears out my pores, it makes them kinda disappear! Please buy this

I am a firm believer in the fact that reviews help customers make decisions on products. So I had to write a review for this product. I'm 37 and recently was finding several deep blackheads on my face in various spots, my chin, my cheeks. Anyway I bought this product in hopes it would help clear them up and just after using this three times a week for two weeks the blackheads are gone. This product is worth the buy if you want to clear up those blackheads.
I have tried every single blackhead remover out there. After a week I noticed a HUGE difference. My blackheads no longer look like the potholes we got in Chicago. Bless.

When I first tried out this product, it made my skin very dry so I stopped using it for a couple of months. After I changed my skin care routine and added snail mucin and hyaluronic acid to my nighttime routine, I decided to give this product another try and I am so glad I did! This product in addition to a SA cleanser is truly a game changer. The blackheads on my nose are almost all gone. I've been using it consistently for a year now.

This product is just okay. Nothing honestly amazing about it. I bought this back in October and it was working just fine. My skin (like others) started to purge. So after the first few time(of purging) it was working. After a few months I've noticed my skin to get really really dry, but it's normal for an exfoliating product (but not normal if you're already dealing with dry skin). What I didn't like is the pump breaking half way through using the product. So now it leaks everywhere. I don't think I will repurchase this again. I did have to move the product into another bottle from a product I previously used up.

My skin is awful. I use prescription ache medicine and it helped but with this product it cleared my skin! Be careful to properly wait for your ph to return to normal if you would like to use this with Retinol products! It only started working well after I used it twice a day. Also, it will cause purging, but I promise it gets better.

I have blackheads on my t-zone area, and thought, "hey, cosrx is reputable company, and the reviews are pretty good, I'll try this product" I wish I was smart enough to make a time machine, go back in time, and smack myself, because this product made my skin so incredibly dry that It looked like my skin was actively falling off of my face. The first thing I noticed was that it smelled a bit like alcohol. This normally isn't an issue, as my skin is in no way sensitive, I have used other products in the past that contain alcohol, and my serums and moisturizers have kept my skin supple. I have no clue what happened here, but it didn't even fix my initial issue of having blackhead in my t-zone area.

ive used this product consistently for close to 3 ish months to get a full grasp on wether or not it works. it does not. def helps with oil control, however my blackheads are still here & thriving. the packaging also allows a lot of leakage & it's pain to travel with bc of that. would recommend the paula's choice liquid exfoliant over this, as it's the only thing thats ever gotten rid of my blackheads (soooo pricey tho).

avis.titre: Learn to use it and it'll work
avis.texte: This is a holy grail product for me. But the people who say it doesn't work, don't know how to use it. First, I have huge pores, blackheads etc and in my mid 40s. You must have cleaned your skin so no blackheads—use a mask, whatever face wash, etc. Once you do, this thing will keep it away and make your skin texture look amazing. Over time I have smoother, healthy skin. Cons: bad directions. I apply with my finger tips on my face and then a roller—which allows me to use much less. Let it soak for 15 min before doing something else. With a roller it's less time. If you apply stuff that contradicts nicianmide or don't let it dry, you'll waste money bc it won't work. This does work. So much slower than a dermatologist trips, but cheaper and it works.

Here is the tea. This is one of my absolute, can never be without holy grail product. I am on my 6th (7th?) bottle of this stuff. It works. Period. No scent. No color. And for my picky sensitive skin - perfect. It keeps my pores unclogged. Best weapon if you get bumps after face waxing. And for those razor, ingrown hairs? Yes works there too! You may get a tiny burn but it goes away very quickly.

avis.titre: Great but not for sensitive skin!!!
avis.texte: I was soooo excited to try this after reading many reviews saying that this is great for sensitive skin. Ummm not all types of sensitive skin can benefit from it! I will say after using this for a month ( once a week) this product does in fact work. A con; this would sting my eyes(I clearly avoid my eyes) though I won't be using this on my face I will be using this on my arms. This is great for my KP.
I was trying to buy something for textured skin and this man tried helping me and recommended me to try this and it burned my skin a bit, I bought this for no reason. This was a waste of money

I originally bought this to try and get rid of the blackheads on and around my nose. Pre-face - I have combination skin with a slightly oily t-zone. I've been using it since March of this year and haven't noticed any significant difference in less blackheads or anything. I don't think the product is worth your money, furthermore, it does close to nothing for pores, blackheads, etc.
i used this on my whole face and it irritated my skin so i stopped. recently ive been spot treating/ only applying it on problem areas and it seems like it works! good stuff, just be careful.

it has gotten rid of a lot of my black heads not all but it's worked well enough and my face isn't as oily and my pores aren't as visible. it will probably take time to become completely clear which is natural and excites me for the day. I can look in the mirror and be happy about how there are less bumps and blackheads.

avis.titre: it's just ok get something better
avis.texte: I have the worst black heads on my nose and chin. All I can really say is it's mid it didn't make them go away it did make them feel smooth but it just gets the surface it doesn't go in the pore to clean. Don't waist your money get something better.

I've been using this as part of my night time routine for the past week or so and I love it. I wash my face and tone before I add this on, then I use a moisturizer to lock it in my skin. My pores definitely look smaller and my blackheads aren't as noticeable.

avis.titre: Not a dupe for PC bha
avis.texte: I've been using this product for a while. I've never seen any skin improvement. Bought this because I didn't wanted to spend a lot on other bhas.. but I'm going back to the expensive ones.. sorry my skin didn't liked it

I have a pretty consistent skincare regimen. I've found what works for me over years of experimentation. I try new products often but usually don't keep them within my regular skincare routine after trying them for a few weeks. But this will be added to my routine. I've used this ONCE and can tell a huge difference in my skin. I have big pores (runs in the fam) and just a lot of texture and tiny whiteheads/blackheads around my nose. I also am a breastfeeding mom so I get hormonal acne. After one use I swear my skin is baby soft, the pores on my nose are clean and I feel like my face is overall softer and less congested. Also the little hormonal breakouts I had on the sides of my face are completely gone over night. I'm in love with this and will be rebuying once it's gone!!
Lesser blackheads and smaller pores. Definitely notice a difference when I ran out

I have dry, very sensitive skin combines with hormonal acne (mid 30's). I use this daily over my entire face and follow it with the COSRX hyaluronic acid intensive cream. I get zero redness and this is the calmest my skin has been in 5+ years. Love this product!!!

I've been using this product for several weeks with no differences at all. It does make your skin feel smoother but I did not notice any difference in the blackheads on my nose at all. Very disappointing

I've been using this daily on my arms and legs for KP for about a week and the improvement is insane! The hairs trapped under the bumps are now naturally finding their way out and the skin is beginning to become much smoother and less irritated. Would definitely recommend for KP. I also am able to use this on my face daily, (that's how gentle it is) and have had excellent results after two months.

avis.auteur: Snail is my new spirit animal
avis.texte: I have tried everything to get rid of my black heads I've bought hundreds of dollars worth of expensive luxary products and nothing followed a strict routine and even did the cureology and seen a dermatologist and could not get rid of them all the way but THIS!! This amazing product is a freaking life saver. It's like half toner half serum (I use it like I would a toner or essence) but it literally took maybe a week of only using at night ( I'm busy and forget to use in am) and I started to see results and this seriously leaves ur skin so soft anx smooth after every use it's amazing. It has seriously changed my skin care routine for the better I seriously get excited to go to bed so I can use this product that's how good it is. Freaking amazing! Do not hesitate on buying it just do it and the bottle is a good freaking size and you only need like 1 maybe 2 pumps so it's going to last you a few months at LEAST! The price point is amazing. Totally worth it you will not regret buying this product

Within the first week of using this product I noticed that I had way less blackheads, my pores minimized in size by half & my acne started clearing fast! Wish I had found this product sooner! I paired this with a Conair True Glow Facial Brush & love the results.
After only one use, my pores already look and feel smaller! Love this product.
I like the viscosity, you don't have to use much. Still waiting to see visible effects though only been using it for a week.

This toner is excellent, but not something that would be a part of my daily routine. I found it can be strong (which is necessary when battling problem areas), but can cause redness and drying if applied too frequently. For my purpose, 2 times per week at bedtime is probably about right for maintenance. Maybe increase to 3 times per week if I am having troublesome breakouts.
I use this as a toner nightly. My oily skin has finally meet it's match and blackheads are gone! Honestly can't tell you how happy I am that I found this product.

avis.titre: Perfect gentle chemical exfoliator for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I was experiencing a lot of tiny breakouts on my forehead and a lot of congestion around my chin. My skin is extremely sensitive, so I was very hesitant to give this a try, but I'm so glad I did! I followed the instructions to a T: once a week for a couple of weeks. Then I slowly introduced it two times a week, and then three times a week. My congestion and breakouts are very minimal now, and when I accidentally skip this, it's definitely noticeable. I guess that's how I know it's working! Highly, highly recommend to people looking for a chemical exfoliant that's gentle and extremely effective. It is a bit pricey, but because it's only meant to be used 2-3 times per week, it will last you quite some time. I also recommend using it at night.

I can not believe how much this product saved my skin. I am used to the Paulas Choice product, however it was the smell that turned me off on that product. This Cosrx product will be a holy grail I just know it.
I don't run out of this, it's thin I just put in my hand them straight on my face & it's made a huge difference in my pores & overall complexion over the last couple of years.

I absolutely LOVE this product! I've been using it for a couple years at this point and cannot live without it. My skin type is dry and prone to congestion. For years I couldn't find a product that would get rid of the little bumps under my skin until I tried this. I suggest it to everyone looking for a good BHA. It has a solid ingredient list and hasn't caused me any irritation or sensitivity. Anyone suffering from maskne should definitely give it a go.
Definitely made my pores noticeably smaller and reduced black heads within 2 weeks!
Been using this for like 2 months now. Did nothing. Still gave bad pores. Did nothing to clear them
I have blackheads on my noses but with this gift provided from Cosrx, not anymore. Buy and try it for yourself. P.S. Love the snail line to.

avis.titre: :( wanted to love it, got cysts instead
avis.texte: I wanted to love this product but it causes me to breakout with cystic acne anytime I use it. I tried slowly adding it to my routine, but even after thinking it was just an initial purging period it continued on.
The BHA is a product, I would definitely recommend it. My skin is very sensitive; I haven't noticed as much redness/reaction to this product as I have when I use others.
Really like this product. It's super light weight and goes on under moisturizer or sunscreen very easily. It's also very mellow on the skin, no irritation or burning whatsoever
I usually use this twice a week when I feel a breakout coming and it stops it pretty much every time. Was wondering however what the percentage of Niacinamide is in this product?

Having mature oily reactive skin I try to play it safe. Which results in not always finding a product that actually improves my skin. Not the case here. BHA Blackhead Power Liquid is making a deep down difference. Smooth fresh skin every day.

avis.titre: Taking it slow and loving it
avis.texte: Word to the wise: BE PATIENT. This isn't my first BHA, but it's the first one I've used correctly. My first go-around, I thought I was indestructible and tried to use one every night, and then the skin on my chin started shredding, so I quit altogether. Several months and a little education later, I started this BHA slowly, just once a week for a couple weeks, and saw no adverse effects, just great looking skin the next morning. I'm up to once every 3-4 days now, and still having no problems with dryness or peeling the next day. I'm just getting over a bout with cystic acne, and I have one cyst left on my cheek. Every time I use this, it's smaller and flatter the next morning, and my scars and dark marks from old cysts seem to be fading faster than they did without a chemical exfoliator. I'm super hyped to break it out in my evening routine when exfoliating day rolls around. I just do a couple pumps in my hands and pat on my skin, no cotton pad needed, and it's going great.

I was really excited to try this - I've tried a ton of other products of the same type and heard/read a bunch of positives about this. However, it's not doing much for me. I have sensitive skin but use chemical exfoliators regularly, and experienced no irritation or dryness with this. I didn't really experience anything else either though. It's a serviceable acid but doesn't do anything that others can't do (dr Dennis gross pads, plethora of liquid toners, resurfacing treatments, acid peels, etc). Maybe if someone hasn't used a ton of AHA/BHAs previously if would be helpful, but I was hoping to see a difference and I don't. Many other people love it and won't go without it, so it's obviously something with my skin. But another positive is that it's pretty inexpensive, so I'm happy to be able to cross it off my list without a big financial hit (P50, I'm looking at you…).

This product is AMAZING. I have tried so many different products and wasted so much money trying to get rid of the blackheads and minimize my pores. This has been the only product that has worked for me. I had tons of blackheads all over my nose and chin, and he really large pores around my nose/cheek area. I was always super self-conscious of them and was constantly trying new stuff to get rid of them. After two days of using this product, my pores were visibly smaller and my blackheads had decreased tremendously!! I don't use a cotton pad as it is wasteful, and just pump some into my hands and apply over my face and follow with my favorite moisturizer. It is seriously SO good and I highly recommend if you are struggling with blackheads/pores/oil like I was!!! < 3

This stuff is really one of the best products out there for blackheads, minimizing pores and keeping acne away. I have fairly oily skin, very enlarged pores and tons of blackheads. I rarely break out but around my period I tend to get 1 or 2 cystic like pimples. I've tried so many other products and none of them worked. I originally bought this for blackheads and it worked wonders after a few weeks. Number of blackheads severely reduced. If I stop using this for even a week it shows immediately. I also noticed my pores decrease in size so much you can barely see them and when used consistently, keeps all pimples away. Truly amazing, def worth a try!

I've used this for years & it really does its job. I don't waste cotton pads (it's wasteful) I just put a couple pumps into my hand & lightly dab it right on my face. It's a must have & I make sure to NEVER run out! I've tried others, paulas choice, p50 & glossiers solution. Not one has come close to the results I've gotten from cosrx, it's really effective without adding anything that's potentially harmful. I have sensitive skin so I research everything before I put it on my skin & I found an article comparing this to the p50, the article broke down why it's so effective (& more affordable)
I have the most sensitive skin ever and these work great for me! Makes my skin glow and feel clean and fresh.
This power liquid is super POWERFUL! My skin is so soft and my pores are looking more and more cleaned out and smaller. Very grateful!

I have combination skin, my skin is dry after cleansing in the AM and gets oily throughout the day. Recently, I've been battling large pore on my cheeks that have been getting congested and clogged easily. The cheek pimples were frequent, they were deep swelling into little mounds, they hurt and were ugly. After cleansing, I applied the toner with my hands by quickly rubbing all over the face and when I did this step... a ton of blackheads from my cheeks would come out sticking onto my palms. It was very gross and I needed some serious help with the blackheads:( I finally decided to try Cosrx Blackhead to use after my toner. It was very gentle and caused no irritation. I used this product everyday and didn't think it was working, but I continued to use it since I already paid $$ for it. After using 3/4 of the bottle, I can attest that the mass of blackheads that would stick to my palms lessened by 90%, no lie. I am now a firm believer that this product works, and I haven't stopped using it since. I highly recommend this product, use it diligently, be patient and see the miracle it can do for you.

This stuff is literally amazing. I've been struggling with stubborn blackheads on my nose for years and nothing has worked on them. I saw a difference in the appearance of my blackheads after the very first time I used the BHA blackhead power liquid! I've used it a couple of times since then and my blackheads clear up more and more with each use. Like I said, this product is AMAZING.

avis.titre: Great Product, But Not For Everyone
avis.texte: I really wanted to try this because I'd heard good things about it. Salicylic acid is too harsh for my skin, so I was excited when I heard that Betaine Salicylate was a gentler alternative. Unfortunately, it was still too harsh, my face burned when I used it, and the reaction I got lasted for a few days. It seems like a great product, just not for sensitive skin.

Was using a well known version for years but keeps raising the price, so while in store asked associate what store carries, she showed me this. This has a pump, works well so far, no irritation, hope to see good benefits to my face, etc.

this works so well for me I swear!!!! The best product ever ! I get really bad big cystic pimples and sometimes underground and when ever I feel it coming i out this stuff on it and it literally goes away with IN A DAY IM NOT EVEN LYING ! I love this sm

I've only been using this for about two weeks (rating reflected or would have given a 5 star). I've never been one to suffer from acne but have always had a blackhead issue since I can remember. Since using this twice a day for a few weeks, I can already tell a difference!!! Can't wait to see what my fave looks like after I finish this bottle. Will definitely be purchasing again!!!!! I also have sensitive skin and this product has not irritated my skin once by using it.

with all bha products, it does take around 2-4 weeks to see results. i had really bad fungal acne, but this cleared it. would highly recommend if the paula's choice bha didn't work for you or if you have fungal acne.

I have struggled with small bumps on my forehead for the longest time and I saw this product was recommended for "fungal acne" and I heard it's safe for sensitive skin. I followed the exact instructions but woke up with small bumps all over my face aka irritation. so I stopped using it and my skin went back to normal and just recently I decided to give it another try knowing it irritated my skin and ....same thing. if anyone is struggling with congested pores and has sensitive skin I highly recommend you try Shiseido senka perfect whip (blue one) with kose softymo deep cleansing oil. avis.titre: Love, love.  I wonderful foe my skin!!

Toners supposedly help skin absorb moisturizer and other skincare routine products, but for me I couldn't tell any difference in how my skin looked and behaved on the days I used it and the days I didn't. I probably won't repurchase.

This has really improved my skin, been using it for about about two months now. Started doing it once a week then gradually increasing to now 3X a week. The day after my skin always looks better. I did have small red bumps in the beginning, but that's to be expected when one is using a new exfoliant. My pores look smaller and dark spots have significantly improved. Definitely on the way to brighter skin!
I'm 27 and have been struggling with acne since middle school. This stuff has helped control my breakouts and makes my skin feel so nice. Highly recommend!!
I watch the Welsh Twins on YouTube and this was recommended and has been a huge help for my skin.

I propose this product be renamed M-A-G-I-C. I've been dealing with a constant breakout for almost this entire year from jojoba oil that just never ended, I initially didn't think this would do anything for me just because I have done many chemical peels in the past. But by golly it did work. After using this just for two days, twice a day, my redness from previous breakouts was significantly reduced to almost gone. Little bumps I had on my cheeks disappeared. AND the tiny almost invisible oil filled bumps on my chin that I've been having to deal with for years are GONE in just a few days. So yea I love this stuff. PS: Because this product has humectants in it ( sodium hyaluronate) I apply this product to lightly damped skin, not sure if that is beneficial or not, but like I said, I've seen great results. If this product is ever discontinued I'll be sad

If you are really looking for a super strong BHA, and your skin is used to them, you might want to skip this. I find this being more effective if u actually use it 2 to 3 times a week and wait atleast 20 mins before applying moisturizer. I have very sensitive skin and I'm impressed on how gentle this is.

I've been dealing with blackheads on my nose forever, but recently I noticed them getting worse and appearing on my chin as well (maybe a result of masks). After literal years of abusing my skin with alcohol-based toners in an attempt to dry out my acne (!!!), I finally made the switch to this because I figured, "Why not?" avis.titre: BEST EVER! Helped my cystic acne/sensitive/oily skin.
avis.texte: Words can't describe how amazing this product is. I've been struggling with cystic acne and clogged pores due to a switch in my birth control. My acne was so bad I barely left my house. Thanks to the derm my skin slowly started healing but I saw the biggest change when I incorporated this product into my routine. I know this is marketed as a blackhead liquid but I truly saw change in every aspect of my skin (including reduced blackheads). The bumps I had all over my chin and forehead reduced substantially after using this product regularly for about 4 weeks. You can seriously feel the softness of your skin after each use and it even kept me feeling moisturized and supple. I get compliments on my skin even when I have no makeup on now!! I never thought I would ever be at this point but I'm so glad I tried it. I've included my before/after pictures below for reference. I recommend using it 1x a day 3x a week to begin and then slowly working up to every day. I use all natural/oil-free products and have a very simple routine. I wash my face morning and night with cetaphil (or a salicylic Dr. Brandt cleanser right before/during my cycle for stubborn hormonal acne) and always follow up with moisturizer. This product is gentle enough that I can combine it with other products such as The Ordinary's niacinamide and/or alpha arbutin. (don't mix this with other strong BHA/AHAS, though.) HOLY GRAIL PRODUCT!
Causes more breakouts and does NOTHING for blackheads. A complete waste of money.

avis.titre: The only product to clear blackheads on my nose!
avis.texte: I don't usually leave product reviews, but I need people to know how well this works. I struggled with blackheads all over my nose for YEARS. I tried topical prescriptions from my derm, pore strips, masks, physical exfoliation, etc., and nothing worked. Enter this product. I've been using it for about a little less than a year now, and it cleans out my nose like nothing ever has before. Please, I beg you, if you are someone who struggles with blackheads on your nose you need to try this! HOWEVER, there is a crucial step to getting this product to work at its max potential! You need to use a toner beforehand. Your skin sits at a pH around 5.5. A BHA exfoliant needs the skin at a MUCH lower pH to work efficiently. Pick up COSRX's AHA/BHA Clarifying Treatment Toner, spritz onto a tissue, dab onto your nose, let dry for a hot second, then go in with this BHA liquid. That's how you will get optimal, lasting results. Good luck, beauties!

I returned this , even though I was pleasantly surprised by my results in the first few uses. Oddly enough I've never had black heads in my life and this was the only major change in my skin care routine... now I've got black heads on my chin? Kind of a redundant product. (Mostly Dry/combo skin)

I use the BHA product every other night (swapping the CosRX AHA when not using this). This was my first chemical exfoliant and was recommended by staff at Ulta for an option that was clean, cruelty free, and not too harsh. I used the BHA for two months prior to adding in the AHA and noticed reduction in the pore size on my nose (my problem spot) within several days. One bottle lasts for MONTHS and makes the price point even better given the long lasting supply.
Best exfoliator ever. I use this as a toner and its not drying or irritating but works fast.

I have dry, sensitive skin that's prone to cystic acne. I had tried using salicylic acid before but it was always so drying! Not this one! I started out using this every couple days and now if I have a breakout starting, I'll use it every night until my skin calms down. It doesn't dry me out at all, even using it that much! This product has helped reduce my cystic acne SO MUCH. I still get them, but they are much smaller and go away so much faster. If I get a really bad cyst, I'll soak a cotton pad with this and leave it on the spot for about 20 minutes and this isn't some cure but it definitely helps it go down faster. It has also helped even out the redness in my skin so I actually don't wear foundation at all anymore! Overall I love this product and the amount you get is insane. I've had this for a few months and for how often I use it (I also use it under my armpits to balance the ph, it's still going strong. I will definitely be repurchasing once I run out.
